paragraph: Granville’s timing system issues a neutral composite reading of 50/100 heading into the bell, capped firmly at 60 due to a classic active divergence where the SPY trends upward while equal-weight breadth (RSP/SPY) falls -1.87%. Underlying leadership remains fiercely top-heavy, driven by powerful expansion in bellwether semiconductors (SOXX/SPY +6.97%) and elevated risk appetite (SPHB/SPLV +5.16%), though a -3.09% drag in transports (IYT/SPY) confirms a lack of broad economic participation. The macro backdrop offers near-term structural support, characterized by a calm VIX at 17.95 in steep contango, stable high-yield spreads at 2.87%, and a softening U.S. Dollar, even as rising 5Y5Y forward inflation expectations (2.28%) and small-cap underperformance limit broader upside momentum. Given the conflict between concentrated mega-cap strength and underlying internal distribution, expect a narrow, range-bound session today with a cautious upward lean strictly confined to high-beta semiconductor momentum.
